title: BodyPosture
description: Schema for a BodyPosture compendium entry (Rpg/Compendium/Posture.cs).

BodyPosture.description: Body posture definition for posture-based movement and combat modifiers.

name.description: Human-readable name of the posture (e.g. stand, crouch, prone).

maxStability.description: Maximum stability for this posture (Target=Body, $0=Movement Intensity).

stabilityRecovery.description: Rate of stability recovery per second for this posture.

heightTolerance.description: Allowed deviation from ideal height in meters.

defensiveness.description: Per-part-tag exposure modifier while in this posture.

onTick.description: Effect executed each tick while in this posture.

canStayInPosture.description: Condition checked every 10 ticks for posture maintenance.

canEnterPosture.description: Condition checked when attempting to enter this posture.
